visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with curly brown hair and a blue bow is seen in a brightly lit clothing store. She is wearing a black t-shirt with a denim collar and a large denim belt. She waves and smiles energetically at the camera, gesturing towards the store interior. (2) The scene shifts to various clothing racks where she picks up a large black tote bag and shows its interior capacity. She then flips through racks of shirts, highlighting patches of a cartoon cat. (3) She interacts with several female store employees dressed in red uniforms. They are all laughing and posing together in front of an orange counter. (4) The woman is then seen in a themed photo booth area designed like a campus locker room with brick walls. She poses with a basketball on an orange chair, making multiple cute facial expressions. (5) Close-up shots of a photo booth screen show her selecting four-frame photo strips. She then holds up the physical printed photo strips to the camera while standing in front of a campus-themed poster featuring a burger-cat. (6) She waves goodbye to the camera while holding the photo strips, ending with a cheerful smile.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog to announce the opening of the Poly Lulu Xinzhuang store and showcase its 'Mindaday' collaboration products. It aims to generate excitement through a high-energy presentation of trendy apparel, exclusive photo booth features, and staff interaction, ultimately inviting viewers to visit and engage with the brand.
